name: cpython-bdba8ef
summary: Rewriting parse_qsl()'s bytes handling to plain bytes(qs) broke support for None/falsy qs (raised TypeError instead of returning []) and silently accepted integers/iterables that bytes() coerces (e.g. bytes(5) produces 5 NUL bytes instead of raising).
evidence: The regressions were introduced in gh-74668 (bdba8ef42b15e651dc23374a08143cc2b4c4657d).

name: cpython-47feb1f
summary: Added a NULL check on sqlite3_column_blob() that treats a zero-length BLOB (for which SQLite returns a NULL pointer) as SQL NULL, so sqlite3 incorrectly returns None instead of b'' for empty blob columns.

name: redis-610eb26
summary: A fix for CLIENT NO-TOUCH / TOUCH-command handling in lookupKey() started dereferencing server.executing_client without checking it for NULL, so unblocking a client blocked on a key (e.g. after BRPOP) via handleClientsBlockedOnKey() crashes the server with a null-pointer dereference.

name: rails-532cd49
summary: New singular/plural inflection regexes for words like 'axis'/'testis' were left unanchored (e.g. /(ax|test)is$/i and /(cris|ax|test)(is|es)$/i), so they also match unrelated words merely ending in those letter sequences (like 'taxis'), producing wrong singular/plural forms.
evidence: fixes a regression introduced by 532cd4, and a bogus test in AP the regression uncovered

name: django-6a6bb16
summary: ConnectionRouter.routers (a cached_property) built its router list by mutating and iterating the same list (self._routers.append(router) inside 'for r in self._routers'), so instantiated router objects get appended and then re-processed, growing without bound instead of producing a fixed list of instantiated routers.

name: go-3636ced
summary: A refactor of unmarshalDecode() to fix extra-data error precedence made every io.EOF unconditionally convert to io.ErrUnexpectedEOF, even on the streaming UnmarshalDecode path where a genuine end-of-stream EOF (not mid-value) should be returned as plain io.EOF.
evidence: This fixes a regression introduced by https://go.dev/cl/689919.

name: core-ed9eb62
match: static content.*(lost|missing)|cached path.*sibling|insertStaticContent.*start.*end|re.?insertion.*missing nodes|only the first node|interior nodes|nodes between (start|the markers)|clones? only
summary: A perf change that reinserts cached static content by cloning already-mounted DOM nodes takes the 'cached' path whenever both start and end markers exist, without checking that the sibling chain between them is still intact; if the static fragment was previously removed node-by-node (e.g. as a component root), interior nodes are lost on re-insertion.
evidence: The regression was introduced in ed9eb62. In the cached code path, we attempt re-insertion by cloning cached nodes. However if the static fragment was removed as component root, it loses the nodes between start and end because each node was removed individually.

name: eslint-f005e24
summary: A 'dead code removal' cleanup in addDeclaredGlobals() dropped the `if (config.env[name])` guard, so globals from an environment are added to the scope even when that env is explicitly set to false in config, contradicting the documented behavior of disabling an env.
evidence: This fixes a regression introduced in f005e2467edda78a6654c4717aa23e99b3289131 (merged as part of 60c51486849c3765ac21fb63e615db2c56b614fd) where globals would get added to environments even when the env was set to `false` in a config file.

name: curl-b1b326e
match: c->running.*never set|cookie engine.*not running|running = true.*inside if\(data\)|cookie_init.*data.*null.*running|running.*(no longer|never|not) (be )?set|(no longer|never|not) set.*running|running.*stays false
summary: A cleanup of Curl_cookie_init() moved `c->running = TRUE` inside the `if(data) { ... }` block, so when the function is called with a NULL Curl_easy (a documented, supported case) the cookie engine's CookieInfo is left permanently marked as not-running.
evidence: This is a regression introduced in b1b326ec500 (shipped in curl 8.1.0)
